About FIS

FAST Islamic Society is a circle of students who sit together, learn together and serve together. We run halaqas, iftars and Seerah nights, and we keep the door open for anyone who feels a little out of place.

President's Message

Dear friends, when I first walked into our halaqa I knew nobody, and somebody saved me a seat. That is all this society is: saved seats. Come and take one.

[President's name]

بَدَأَ الإِسْلَامُ غَرِيبًا، وَسَيَعُودُ كَمَا بَدَأَ غَرِيبًا، فَطُوبَى لِلْغُرَبَاءِ

Islam began as something strange, and it will return to being strange, so glad tidings to the strangers.
